prompt: Fog drifts slowly past the streetlamp, the man shifts his weight and breathes in the cold air, the woman in the tram turns her head slightly, all the lights stay on and the same. Static locked-off camera, no cuts, no zoom. The lighting stays the same, no light turns off, no fade to black. Gentle natural motion: the people breathe, blink and move slightly; small details move slowly. Film grain, calm, cinematic.
